product.description: Monoprice™USB‑C to HDMI KVM Extender Kit ‑ Over HDBaseT 3.0, 4K60Hz, USB 2.0, up to 230ftReliable USB‑C KVM Extension with 4K Video and Full USB ControlThis USB‑C™ KVM Extender Kit delivers smooth 4K video and responsive USB 2.0 control over a single Cat6A cable.
